title: Nationwide Building Society Annual Report and Accounts 2026
publication_date_evidence: Issuer Review of the Year 2026, printed p. 12, states availability from 8 June 2026.
retrieval_reference: Issuer results page and original freely accessible annual-report PDF, verified against Group columns on printed pp. 156, 186, 188 and 191. Accounting/perimeter notes pp. 192–193.
reporting_period: FY2026 ended 31 March 2026 and published FY2025 Group comparatives
review_notes: Selected numerical facts independently transcribed; no copied report layout, prose, publisher logos or third-party material. Only bounded analysis and homepage attribution. More recent interim results are outside the modelled series.

rights.method_review: Open issuer report via ordinary public access; bounded independent numerical facts and original analysis. No applicable term located on the report or public results route for the scoped use. No licence assertion or bulk collection.
